r6_result.case27_mechanism: commit-plan mode (r6 implementation) never engaged in practice: the guard required the current-world waypoint/unusable checks, which the stale red_1 margins made fail on every blocked tick, so the plan was still replaced each tick; behavior matched r5c (18 refreshes, approach 20.9 s + search 38.8 s, no translation after ~18 s).

r7_change.rule: on a successful selection, freeze the path, goal and the feasible constraints (radius/discs/rects) and drive that frozen plan with the existing next_plan = now + 1 s boundary, before the peer-route/escape/progress-recovery blocks; when the boundary is reached the normal replan/refresh cycle resumes.
r7_change.basis: r5c/r6 logs show the robot needs ~0.36 m but only ever received ~0.1 s of driving per refresh cycle; a 1 s committed window is 10x. No new time constant.
